Keep the root transparent, full-view text at least 11px after fitting, and every original dataset in full view. Thumbnails follow a six-second authored scroll story whose 40% checkpoint is the exact v4 composition. Stop autoplay on native user input. Reduced motion renders the checkpoint still and jumps between full scroll-linked states. The shell owns Scroll ↓, Reset and Replay; do not draw demo-driver buttons. Freeze native scrolling, frames and clocks on caller/viewport/document holds and clean up listeners and observers on disposal. Compact transforms are projections anchored to the v4 pose; full interaction formulas remain unchanged.
